method.bracket: after-cost +3R target / -1R stop threshold; adverse stop gaps retained
method.execution: wait for a fully post-signal synchronized 15-minute option bar, then hold into following sessions
method.instrument: trade each confirming SPY/QQQ/IWM 7+DTE $5 debit vertical
method.signal: 14:45 New York completed-bar N-session return, confirmed by >=2 indices
method.validation: 25-session rolling train, 2-session embargo, unique 10-session OOS with nested selection
